lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular high-luminance blobs are visible posterior to the gills, extending toward the caudal region. The blobs are spaced roughly equidistantly along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to create a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the superior edge and darker pixels on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits a significant indentation or missing tissue on its posterior margin. A thin, linear trailing feature is visible near the base of the dorsal fin. A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral area posterior to the pectoral fin.
